selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api runs as a managed service
selected_evidence.summary: The systemd unit is enabled and active, uses Restart=always, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, and serves valid health and inventory responses.

selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api remains available during system OOM
selected_evidence.summary: The API stayed healthy as available memory fell to 47 MiB. The independent monitor recorded 296 successful probes, the API retained PID 1323, and NRestarts remained zero.

selected_evidence.requirement: The kernel stops the memory hog
selected_evidence.summary: The hog ran with oom_score_adj=1000. Kernel logs identify memory-hog PID 1517 as the OOM victim at 1,776,288 KiB anonymous RSS; systemd reports Result=oom-kill.

Pre-restart boot ID was 18d6ac04-b8ce-4113-936c-32451b2a609e; the native systemd reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to d503723c-8042-4005-ba41-199aa4aebdbb. The system returned to running state and inventory-api recovered enabled, active, protected, listening, and serving both endpoints.

commands.command:
cat > /tmp/inventory-health-monitor.py <<'MONITOR_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json, time, urllib.request
url = "http://" + __import__("os").environ["TARGET_IP"] + ":8080/health"
results = []
start = time.monotonic()
while time.monotonic() - start < 30:
    now = time.time()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1) as response:
            body = response.read().decode()
            ok = response.status == 200 and json.loads(body).get("status") == "ok"
            results.append((now, "ok" if ok else "bad-response"))
    except Exception as exc:
        results.append((now, "error:" + type(exc).__name__))
    time.sleep(0.1)
with open("/tmp/inventory-health-results.log", "w") as output:
    for when, result in results:
        output.write("%.6f %s\n" % (when, result))
MONITOR_EOF
cat > /tmp/memory-hog.py <<'HOG_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import time
chunks = []
megabytes = 0
while True:
    chunk = bytearray(8 * 1024 * 1024)
    chunk[::4096] = b"X" * (len(chunk) // 4096)
    chunks.append(chunk)
    megabytes += 8
    print("allocated_mb=%d" % megabytes, flush=True)
    time.sleep(0.05)
HOG_EOF
chmod 0755 /tmp/inventory-health-monitor.py /tmp/memory-hog.py; /usr/bin/python3 -m py_compile /tmp/inventory-health-monitor.py /tmp/memory-hog.py; rm -f /tmp/inventory-health-results.log; TARGET_IP="$NODE_IP" systemd-run --unit=inventory-health-monitor --property=OOMScoreAdjust=-500 --setenv=TARGET_IP="$NODE_IP" /tmp/inventory-health-monitor.py

systemd-run --unit=memory-hog --property=OOMScoreAdjust=1000 /tmp/memory-hog.py; sleep 1; hogpid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value memory-hog.service); printf 'hog_pid=%s\n' "$hogpid"; printf 'hog_oom_score_adj='; cat "/proc/$hogpid/oom_score_adj"; systemctl is-active inventory-api.service; curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 2 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; printf '\n'
